dataset: CIFAR-100 official test set (10000 images, 100 fine classes, 20 superclasses)
eval_script: frozen: same CIFAR-100 test split for every node; ECE uses 15 equal-width bins as Guo et al. 2017

protocol.note: standard CIFAR-100 companion; not in Guo tables
fraction of test images whose predicted fine class is wrong but in the same CIFAR-100 superclass
Expected Calibration Error, 15 bins (Guo et al.)

number_sources.paper: copied from the cited paper/table on CIFAR-100
number_sources.transferred: relative gain from a paper on a nearby backbone, applied to this DAG's parent
number_sources.derived: filled by a fixed formula from top1_acc because the paper did not print that column
number_sources.frozen_preds: top1/top5/macro_f1/confuse_similar copied from parent (post-hoc calibration does not change argmax)
